title: Stunning New Vampire Anime Is The Castlevania Replacement Fans Needed
content:
With Castlevania: Nocturne having come to an end in early 2025, anime fans have been caught in a vampire drought over the last year, which is unfortunate, as the genre as come back full force thanks to the success of massive live-action properties like Nosferatu and The Vampire Lestat breaking into the mainstream. Just in time for 2027, a collaboration from ZERO-G x Liber is coming to save anime fans and bring vampires back to the forefront of the medium. Dropping a trailer, key visual, character art as well as full staff and cast information, ZERO-G x Liber has announced an anime adaptation of Kyo Shirodaira and Yuri Kimura’s The Record of a Fallen Vampire .

The series follows an ancient vampire king, King Akabara “Red Rose” Strauss, who lost his vampiric empire and queen after she was sealed away by humans. Akabara has spent thousands of years searching for his lost love, and as the story begins, he encounters the 49th Black Swan — a powerful entity who inhabits the body of a human woman, bestowing her with the power to defeat the vampire king and his queen.

The Record of a Fallen Vampire Has a Star-Studded Production Team

The Record of a Fallen Vampire hasn’t received a firm release date outside of its 2027 window just yet, however, ZERO-G x Liber have revealed who will be working on the series, and the production staff is just what the series needs to bring it to life. At the helm of the project working on series composition and lead director is Mankyu, who previously worked on the 2023 anime adaptation of Migi & Dali ; character designs for The Record of a Fallen Vampire will be handled by jimao, who worked on previous Liber projects like The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague , and an original soundtrack from Evan Call, famously known for his work on Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End and Violet Evergarden .

Yuma Uchida will be taking the lead role as the vampire King Akabara, who has previosuly been heard in massive series like Jujutsu Kaisen as Megumi Fushigoro , Fruits Basket as Kyo Soma, Blue Lock as Reo Mikage, and Banana Fish as Ash Lynx. Taking on the role of Bridget Irving Frostheart, the Black Swan bestowed with the power to slay Akabra is Aino Shimada, best known for her role as Takeko Nishino in Classroom of the Elite , and Bee in the Japanese dub of Bee and Puppycat .

King Akabara’s Story Is A Classic Brought To Life After Decades Of Waiting

Originally published in 2003 in Square Enix’s Monthly Shonen Gangan , The Record of a Fallen Vampire is a beautifully illustrated dark fantasy manga that ran for four years , concluding in 2007 with a sequel series that just began serializing in October 2026, returning to Monthly Shonen Gangan titled The Record of a Fallen Vampire: A Dog’s Song For Dogs . The original series has since been collected into nine volumes, and has been previously licensed by Viz Media and Yen Press for English publication.

The story itself is filled with interpersonal conflict between mortals, half-vampires called dhampirs, and vampires themselves, all through the lens of the ever-omnipotent King Akabara, who has seen the world grow and change through over the course of thousands of years as he tries to track down his queen. His stoic worldview gives the audience an outside looking in perspective to the lives of human beings constantly trying to survive in a world ravaged by the whims of bloodthirsty beings trying to hunt them down.

The old school gothic art style used in the manga creates lush paneling and stunning set pieces the new anime adaptation has potential to draw from as well, meaning that ZERO-G x Liber have the opportunity to create something truly special with their take on The Record of a Fallen Vampire .

title: shallm Perform Opening Theme Song for 'Now That We Draw' Anime
content:
The anime will premiere in January 2027.

Ayumu Murase and Sayumi Suzushiro will star as Yūki Uehara and Niina Miyamoto, respectively:

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Dweeby high schooler Yūki Uehara has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she's bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara's dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Niina Miyamoto—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara's concocted, and he certainly isn't the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI- ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , and Deko Akao ( Arakawa Under the Bridge , Komi Can't Communicate ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Hiromi Nakagawa ( WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is designing the characters, and Infinite is producing.

The additional staff includes:

The manga launched in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in 2023, and Hakusensha published the eighth compiled book volume on September 29. Seven Seas Entertainment published the fifth volume in English on July 28.

title: 12 Years Later, Major Shonen Jump Anime Shares New Look at Reboot Return
content:
Reboots of popular anime series aiming to more closely follow the original source material. Popular franchises like Fullmetal Alchemist , Hunter x Hunter , and Fruits Basket have all gotten the proper reboot treatment, and it seems as though there are even more anime on the horizon aiming to do right by what the original creator had in mind for the series. Toei Animation has recently announced that they’ve picked up Daisuke Ashihara’s sci-fi shonen manga World Trigger for a brand-new animated reboot scheduled to release in 2027. The manga originally released in 2013 in Weekly Shonen Jump , and received a three season long anime adaptation from 2014 until 2022.

The reboot, titled World Trigger 1st Season , will be a ground-up re-adaptation of the manga from the very beginning that aims to improve the pacing of specific story arcs from the manga with improved art and animation. As of writing, there hasn’t been an official release date announced regarding when the reboot will launch in the new year, however, it has been confirmed that there will be new details revealed during Jump Festa 2027’s Red Super Stage. It’s also been confirmed that the World Trigger reboot will see the main cast from the original anime adaptation reprising their roles. Check out the new look at the reboot below.

World Trigger’s First Anime Adaptation Was Plagues With Production Issues

The 2014 anime adaptation of World Trigger from Toei Animation has been heavily criticized by fans of the series for its low-budget looking visuals, poorly implemented filler arc, and issues with pacing canon story materials from the manga. The animation quality was stiff, and used 3D models for the monsters that appear throughout the series that contrasted heavily from the 2D animation used for the character models and backdrops. Episode structure was similarly frustrating, with drawn out recap segments at the beginning of each episode coupled with drawn-out opening sequences and end-credit shorts that padded episode runtimes so heavily that any actual story progression would only get about 15 minutes of screen time.

Considering the first season of the original anime was 73-episodes in length, these frustrations were glaringly obvious, and, for a series based on one of the top-selling manga in the 2010s, infuriating for fans. While the rebooted anime slated for 2027 is planning to more faithfully handle its source material, the same staff members who produced the 2014 series will be returning to work on the project, which is reasonably concerning for many. However, fans are hopeful that the team working on the series will be able to bring Daisuke Ashihara’s smash-hit shonen series to life in the way it deserves.

World Trigger Is An Action Shonen Like No Other

World Trigger takes place in a fictionalized version of Japan four years after a mysterious gate appears in Mikado City. Leading to an alternate world, beings called Neighbors begin pouring into the “real-world.” While humanity tries to adapt and fight back against the creatures, their technology and weaponry struggle to make a dent in their forces. The National Defense Agency eventually devise technology to appropriate and adapt the Neighbors defenses to allow humans access to a modicum of their abilities. The series’s protagonist, Yuma Kuga — a humanoid Neighbor living amongst mankind tries to blend in and evade defensive forces only to befriend a trainee whose vowed to destroyed Neighbors.

Daisuke Ashihara’s original work takes the age-old “fish-out-of-water” concept and truly flips it on its head in World Trigger , playing with political commentary in a story filled with fantastical abilities and sci-fi technology. The original manga is beyond stunning as well, and as of 2023 has sold more than 15 million copies around the world. Needless to say, if there’s any anime that deserves a second chance at becoming the next major mainstream shonen anime , it’s World Trigger .

title: 'Go with the Clouds, North by Northwest' Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals 2027 Premiere on Netflix
content:
The official website for the television anime of Aki Irie 's Go with the Clouds, North by Northwest ( Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Yuke ) manga began streaming on Friday the first promotional video, and it reveals that Tomohiro Ōno will star as Kei Miyama. The website also unveiled a visual and the 2027 premiere on TBS with worldwide exclusive streaming on Netflix . Netflix streamed an English-subtitled version of the trailer:

Vertical licensed the manga in 2018. Kodansha USA Publishing is now releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

From the creator of Ran And The Gray World , Aki Irie . The story takes place in Iceland, at land's end, 64ºN. Kei Miyama is a 17-year-old with three secrets: he can talk to cars, he can't handle pretty girls, and he works as a private investigator. One case has him searching for a beloved dog, another involves reuniting a woman with a man she fell for at first sight. And then comes a case that strikes close to home-searching for his own little brother. Tag along as this globe-spanning journey unfolds…

Irie launched Go with the Clouds, North by Northwest in 2016 in Harta . The manga moved to Kadokawa 's Aokishi from Harta when the former launched. After Aokishi stopped serializing the series in February 2025, a new company Yukiwarisо̄ announced in October 2025 that it would publish it. The first compiled book volume of the manga's "second series," a continuation of the original series under new publishing and volume counts, shipped on April 30. The original manga's seventh volume shipped in Japan in 2024.

title: 'Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike' Reveals Lead Cast, Staff, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Aki Irie 's Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike ( Go with the Clouds, North-by-Northwest ) manga revealed the lead cast, main staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere on TBS in 2027 and will stream worldwide exclusively on Netflix.

Voice actors Tomohiro Ono ( Tomodachi Game ) is starring as the lead character Kei Miyama.

Staff Chief Director, Series Composition: Takashi Sano ( Kami no Tou director) Director: Yousuke Kubo ( Madougushi Dahliya wa Utsumukanai ) Character Design: Chikashi Kubota ( One Punch Man ) Studio: Qzil.la

Irie originally began serializing the supernatural drama manga in Harta magazine in March 2016 before transferring it to the Aokishi magazine in April 2021, where it ran until February 2025 when she became a freelancer. Kadokawa published the seventh volume in February 2024. Yukiwarisou, a new publishing company, released the first sequel volume on April 30. Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike has a cumulative 1.6 million copies of its volumes in print.

Kodansha licensed the manga in English in 2018 and released the seventh volume in April 2025.

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Reveals Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast members on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 7 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame.

Voice actors Mao Ichimichi ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken ), Natsumi Takamori ( 5-toubun no Hanayome ), and Miyuki Sakurai ( Kekkon Yubiwa Monogatari II ) joined the cast as Hikaru's classmate.

Yui Umemoto ( Ninja Kamui ) is directing at E&H Production , with Takayuki Sano ( Bullet/Bullet episode director) is serving as the assistant director. Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) is handling the series composition and Satomi Watanabe ( Aikatsu! ) is designing the characters. Yuki Kajiura ( Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica ), Takumi Ozawa ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ), and Shiho Terada ( Inazuma Eleven Go ) are composing the music.

CLAMP serialized the manga in Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. A sequel manga began in the same month and ended in March 1996.

Tokyopop licensed both manga in 1997, followed by Dark Horse Comics in 2009, and then Kodansha USA in 2019 with two hard-cover box sets containing three volumes each.

title: Crunchyroll Acquires The Apothecary Diaries Anime Film
content:
The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as Mu Qing (English romanization not confirmed).

The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyūga began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print.

title: Manga 'Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover' Ends in Next Chapter
content:
The official X account for author Koushi announced on Thursday that the Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ( You Are a Four Leaf Clover ) manga will end with its next chapter. The 106th and final chapter is scheduled to be released on Weekly Shounen Champion issue 2026 No.46 on October 15. The final chapter will have page count of two chapters.

Koushi launched the romantic suspense manga in Weekly Shounen Champion magazine in July 2024. Akita Shoten published the 11th volume on October 7, with the 12th and final volume scheduled for a December 8 release.

An anime adaptation was announced with the release of the 10th manga volume on September 8.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Anime Film Acquired by Crunchyroll for Global Theatrical Release
content:
Crunchyroll has acquired the North American and worldwide distribution rights for The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure anime film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will distribute the film, with theatrical release dates to be announced. The worldwide distribution excludes Asia but includes India.

The movie is the first theatrical feature in The Apothecary Diaries franchise and features a new mystery written by original series creator. Norihiro Naganuma directs, with TOHO Animation STUDIO handling animation production. The movie will premiere in Japan on December 11, 2026.

The official film synopsis reads:

The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water. The emperor gives Jinshi an order. He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they’re in pristine condition. She’s beautiful, as if she were still alive. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan. They arrive at a bustling city on the water. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away. “I hope nothing happens…” Jinshi’s premonition comes true. On the day of the concubine’s funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

Natsu Hyuga writes the The Apothecary Diaries light novel, with illustrations by Toko Shino. The series is serialized by Shunfunotomo. The series has 2 manga adaptations, one written by Itsuki Nanao and illustrated by Nekokurage, and one written and illustrated by Minoji Kurata.

J-Novel Club is publishing the novel in English, while Squre Enix is publishing the manga. The story follows Maomao, a young apothecary who ends up getting sold to the emperor’s palace as a lowly servant. She’s not the type of character who can just stay obedient, so she ends up helping Jinshi, the handsome official at the palace.

The franchise recently also announced its first live-action series adaptation , as well as the first console game . The Failure at God School , a manga with story written by Natsu Hyuga, also recently announced an anime adaptation .

title: New The Apothecary Diaries Movie Confirms U.S. Release With Big Screen Plans
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is back in action this Fall with the third season of the TV anime series , and it has been confirmed that the new feature film debut for the franchise is coming to the big screen across North America too. The Apothecary Diaries has quickly become one of the most popular franchises in just the last few years, and after two seasons of the TV series the franchise is set to expand with all other sorts of franchises. These include the now airing third season, and a new feature film.

Along with the release of the third season of the TV anime series, The Apothecary Diaries is also going to hit theaters in Japan later this Decembe r with its very first feature film outing. Thankfully, Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have now confirmed that the new film will be releasing across theaters in North America and worldwide territories in the near future. Which is something that fans of the anime can look forward to as it teases a brand new story from the original creator themselves.

The Apothecary Diaries Movie Confirms U.S. Theaters Release

Officially licensed under the title of The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure , Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have confirmed via press release that the new feature film outing will be heading to theaters across North America and worldwide territories (excluding Asia) at a later date. No concrete release window or date for the international release of the movie has yet to be revealed as of this time of the initial announcement, but release details will be confirmed soon enough given that it’s going to be releasing in Japan soon.

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure will be hitting theaters in Japan on December 11th , so fans won’t have to wait too much longer to find out more about the project and its international release soon enough. Directed by Norihiro Naganuma for TOHO Animation STUDIO, the new movie features an original story from series creator Natsu Hyuuga that was not seen in the original light novel releases. And as one would expect from such an outing, there’s a big new mystery that Maomao is going to need to figure out.

What’s Next for The Apothecary Diaries?

The Apothecary Diaries has even more planned alongside the release of its new movie (of which you can watch the trailer for the Japanese release in the video above). You can currently find the latest episodes of Season 3 of the TV anime now streaming with Crunchyroll as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and then it will be returning for its second half next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule hitting next year. But there are also some other big projects now in the work for the increasingly popular franchise.

The Apothecary Diaries is also coming our way next year with a brand new video game release, and is also in the works on a new live-action series with Prime Video . On top of the now releasing light novel and manga releases, there’s more of The Apothecary Diaries than ever. Are you excited to see The Apothecary Diaries on the big screen? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
